## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- ProcessFingerprintEngine
- 1. Fingerprint contains all 12 features per signal
- 2. Same process → similarity score > 0.9
- 3. Different process → similarity score < 0.5
- 4. Drift detection: out of control when process changes
- 5. Drift detection: in control for stable process
